title: [FMLA 15] SimpPendulum — Cycle of Simple Pendulum
summary: Period of a simple pendulum for small angles.

body.text: Calculator scroll name: SimpPendulum. Period of a simple pendulum for small angles.
A longer playground swing takes longer to come back. That is T = 2π √(L/g). The dashed positions are the ends of a small arc.

body.caption: A bob on a string of length L. For small swings, only L and g set the period — the mass does not appear.

body.title: How to run
items: Press FMLA, then 1, then 5 (or scroll to the name and EXE)

body.label: CONST / g
body.text: Small-angle period. Uses g from ROM. Enter length L in metres (L > 0); T is in seconds.
